latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Maker Free Download — fast AI video editing with no software to install.

- Upload video clips (MP4, MOV) or images (JPG, PNG) up to 500MB and describe your project to generate finished MP4 videos in 1–2 minutes.
- Automatic session and token management — supports free anonymous usage with 100 free credits (valid for 7 days).
- Workflow includes upload, timeline editing, audio/text overlays, and rapid export in 1080p MP4 format.
- Supports easy file uploads and manages cloud GPU-based video rendering; no technical steps required from users.
- Built-in error handling and guidance for unsupported formats, export limits, and credit management.
- Ideal for casual creators and small business owners looking for no-fuss, browser-based video creation.
